item.title: Amazon delivery drone strikes North Texas apartment, causing minor damage
The 'Little red dots' observed by Webb were direct-collapse black holes
item.description:
📝 Initially, astronomers hypothesized that they could be massive star-forming regions, but this was inconsistent with established cosmological models. This differs from conventional models that predict how black holes form from the collapse of massive stars. Over time, these black holes would then merge with other black holes (via galactic mergers and other mechanisms) to form massive black holes (MBHs).
🔗 Read more: https://phys.org/news/2026-02-red-dots-webb-collapse-black.html

item.title: Credentials for Linux: Bringing Passkeys to the Linux Desktop
item.description:
📝 Credentials for Linux (FOSDEM 2026) 1st February 2026 Bringing Passkeys to the Linux desktop Talk at FOSDEM 2026 in Brussels, Belgium. This talk presents Credentials for Linux (github. We’ll cover: Very short refresher on passkeys & platform authenticators: Why WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkeys matter, what platform authenticators are, and how this is solved on Windows Hello, Android and Apple platforms today, and the current state on Linux.
